verdict.rationale: Kommo's docs mention 'pipelines' as a system interface location and 'lead stage changes' as automation triggers. That implies the product has a stage-based pipeline view of leads, but the evidence pack never actually describes the visual pipeline itself. Missing for 10: documented visual pipeline/board view, customizable stage creation or editing, drag-and-drop deal movement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates

citations.quote: Display your layout in allowed system locations such as lead or contact cards, lists, pipelines, dashboard, etc.
The constructor enables you to set up automatic system reactions for events such as lead stage changes and website visits.
